title: Perfect contrition
html_source:
PERFECT CONTRITION
Sorrow for sin arising from perfect love. In perfect contrition the sinner detests sin more than any other evil, because it offends God, who is supremely good and deserving of all human love. Its motive is founded on God’s own personal goodness and not merely his goodness to the sinner or to humanity…Perfect contrition removes the guilt and eternal punishment due to grave sin, even before sacramental absolution.
